verdict.rationale: Missive documents rule-based automation ('Automate your workflows', up to 1000 rules) and an MCP-based AI Copilot/agent integration, but nothing in the evidence describes scheduling recurring or time-based jobs/workflows (e.g., cron-like triggers, recurring agent runs). Snoozing is a one-time defer, not a recurring scheduler, and MCP docs describe on-demand agent actions rather than scheduled/recurring jobs.
